objective: Turn staged warehouse payloads into evidence-rich intake-QC candidates using fail-fast receipt integrity and read-only archive metadata, without repeatedly extracting unchanged source archives.
global_rules: Never overwrite or delete original staged source payloads during preparation.
Verify staged source receipt SHA256 before extracting or classifying.

ZIP is inspected read-only during critical-gap preparation; physical extraction is deferred to explicit class-specific conversion/import work. RAR/7Z remain pending unless an approved extractor exists.
Block executable/script payloads and BMP textures from production intake.
Animated character/creature/fauna final production assets require FBX.
Production textures accepted by the project are PNG/TGA; channel-packing debt remains explicit until actually authored.
Audio production masters require WAV before UE import.
No processing car may promote an item to READY_FOR_IMPORT without class-specific QC.
Hero identity/canon acceptance is separate from technical format readiness.
Repeated static detail remains an ISM/HISM candidate; crowds/fauna remain pooling candidates.

cars.goal: Verify receipts/hashes and detect duplicate payloads.
Extract ZIP copies, inventory RAR/7Z debt, block dangerous files/BMP.
Inventory FBX static-mesh candidates and separate OBJ/glTF conversion debt.
Find skeletal FBX candidates for Frodo/Gandalf/Sam/shared rig families without claiming identity fit.
Inventory FBX animation libraries by locomotion/social/combat/mounted naming.
Inventory animated animal/creature FBX candidates and retain skeleton/deformation debt.
Inventory settlement/fortification/dungeon/ruin FBX packs by region-support role.
Inventory furniture/food/market/farm/camp/household candidates.
Inventory tree/shrub/grass/reed/rock nature stock and explicit LOD/cull debt.
Group albedo/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/height files into source material sets.
Report PNG/TGA-ready textures, non-production formats, oversized source files and channel-pack debt.
Separate WAV masters from OGG/MP3/FLAC/ZIP source conversion debt.
Classify footsteps/ambience/foley/fire/water/fauna/impact candidates by filename/category.
Keep music, voice/TTS and SFX lanes separated and prevent reference-only promotion.
Inventory flipbook/image-sequence/video/source VFX stock with conversion debt explicit.
Inventory PNG/SVG/icons/fonts and Arabic-localization support files.
Inventory heightmap/GIS/terrain-source candidates without runtime integration.
Map prepared candidates to the 28 warehouse region slots without duplicating shared families.
Record byte-size/count/format/instance-policy metadata before engine profiling.
Emit explicit prepared/pending/blocked counts and class-QC debt; never auto-promote.

evidence_boundary: Technical warehouse preparation only. ZIP inspection is metadata-only and does not promote/extract source payloads. No hero identity, skeletal deformation, visual, PIE, device or performance acceptance is created by this train.
